value.rationale: Example 6.1 is a concrete newly introduced NMDS EGRL code whose source reports only ordinary codeword weights. A complete higher-dimensional support census is a natural structural invariant: it determines not just the standard generalized-weight minima but the abundance of every support size, including 165 minimum-support two-dimensional subcodes and 55 minimum-support three-dimensional subcodes. These counts can inform comparison, shortening/puncturing incidence, and higher-support geometry without requiring a family-wide theorem.
